These three `display` values decide how an element takes part in layout flow: | | `block` | `inline` | `inline-block` | |---|---|---|---| | Starts a new line | Yes (takes the whole row) | No (sits on the same line) | No (same line) | | `width`/`height` | Respected | **Ignored** | Respected | | Vertical `margin`/`padding` | Fully applied (pushes layout) | Horizontal only; **vertical does not push** layout | Fully applied | - **`block`**: `

Lưu ý: layout hiện đại thường dùng flex/grid cho việc sắp xếp, nhưng ba giá trị nền tảng này vẫn quyết định hành vi mặc định của từng thẻ.

These three display values decide how an element takes part in layout flow:

blockinlineinline-block
Starts a new lineYes (takes the whole row)No (sits on the same line)No (same line)
width/heightRespectedIgnoredRespected
Vertical margin/paddingFully applied (pushes layout)Horizontal only; vertical does not push layoutFully applied
  • block: <div>, <p>, <h1>, <section> — takes all available width, stacked as a column.
  • inline: <span>, <a>, <strong> — only as wide as its content, flowing within a text line; width/height have no effect.
